personalInfo.statement: My name is Thomas McElroy, I am 19 years old, and I just transferred from CPCC to UNCC. This is my first semester here, and I am a Computer Science major, IT Concentration. I would like to work in Systems Administration after finishing my degree.
personalInfo.personalBackground: I have lived in Charlotte my whole life, and been interested in computers for most of it.
personalInfo.professionalBackground: I work at the Microcenter on South Boulevard.
personalInfo.academicBackground: I just transferred from CPCC with an Associates degree, and hope to complete my Bachelors degree here in 2028.
personalInfo.primaryWorkComputer: Lenovo Thinkpad x280, Arch Linux, Linux kernel version 7.0.12-arch1-1 ( Arch does not have clear versioning like fixed release operating systems ). Dual booted with Windows 11, which I can use for any exams that may need lockdown browser, but almost never use otherwise.
personalInfo.primaryWorkLocation: UNCC Campus, in any of the Woodward study rooms.
personalInfo.alternateComputerLocation: If I couldn’t use my x280, or wasn’t on campus, I would use any of my other laptops, or if at home, desktops, likely from my bed.

courses.courseTitle: Intro to Info Security and Priv
courses.reasonForTaking: I am interested in Cybersecurity, privacy, and server administration, so information security knowledge is helpful to me.

When designing UIs, it is valuable to be able to think about how a normal user will approach them, because I am far from a normal user ( I use vim keybindings for all apps, and prefer to do everything in a terminal ), and so i struggle sometimes to imagine how people will approach the things I make. This class teaches you how to do that.
This is a required course for a Computer Science degree, and gets you better at discrete math, boolean algebra, and conditional statements, which are helpful for programming.
This is a required course for a Computer Science degree, and helps you with information needed with getting through college, and applying for jobs.
I am interested in creating tools and automations for things, and so being able to make web frontends for those tools and automations is hugely helpful, so that other people can use them.
